ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
The wheel shown below consists of two circles and five spokes, with a label at each point where a spoke meets a circle. A bug walks along the wheel, starting at point \(A\). At every step of the process, the bug walks from one labeled point to an adjacent labeled point. Along the inner circle the bug only walks in a counterclockwise direction, and along the outer circle the bug only walks in a clockwise direction. For example, the bug could travel along the path \(AJABCHCHIJA\), which has \(10\) steps. Let \(n\) be the number of paths with \(15\) steps that begin and end at point \(A\). Find the remainder when \(n\) is divided by \(1000\).

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the wheel has five equally placed spokes, with inner/outer pairs A-J, E-F, D-G, C-H, and B-I around the wheel. Index the five spoke positions clockwise from the top as s=0,1,2,3,4, so inner labels are A,E,D,C,B and outer labels are J,F,G,H,I. From the text, an inner-circle move is counterclockwise, so it changes s by -1; an outer-circle move is clockwise, so it changes s by +1; a spoke move changes only the ring, not s. Start and end at inner ring, s=0. Introduce a variable z to track the spoke-position displacement modulo 5. The one-step transfer matrix between ring states inner/out is M(z) = [[z^{-1}, 1], [1, z]], where the diagonal entries represent circle moves and the off-diagonal entries represent spoke moves. The desired count is the root-of-unity filtered value (1/5) sum over z^5=1 of the inner-inner entry of M(z)^15. Since det M(z)=0 and trace M(z)=z+z^{-1}, M(z)^15=(z+z^{-1})^14 M(z), so the needed entry is z^{-1}(z+z^{-1})^14. Expanding gives terms C(14,k) z^{13-2k}; the fifth-root filter keeps only exponents divisible by 5, so 13-2k≡0 mod 5, giving k=4,9,14. Thus n=C(14,4)+C(14,9)+C(14,14)=3004, and the remainder modulo 1000 is 4.

图像描述：图中是一个由两个同心圆和五条辐条组成的轮子。五条辐条分别连接内外圆上的成对标记点：顶部为 A-J，右侧为 E-F，右下为 D-G，左下为 C-H，左侧为 B-I。按从顶部开始顺时针排列五个辐条位置，内圈标签依次是 A, E, D, C, B，外圈标签依次是 J, F, G, H, I。

推理：令五个辐条位置按顺时针编号为 s=0,1,2,3,4，其中 A 在内圈 s=0，J 在外圈 s=0。题意规定：在内圈只能逆时针走，所以位置编号变化为 s -> s-1；在外圈只能顺时针走，所以位置编号变化为 s -> s+1；沿辐条走只改变内外圈，不改变 s。

用变量 z 记录位置编号的位移，内外圈作为两个状态。一步转移矩阵为 M(z) = [[z^{-1}, 1], [1, z]]，其中第一行/列对应内圈，第二行/列对应外圈。我们要从内圈 s=0 的 A 出发，15 步后回到内圈且 s≡0 mod 5，因此需要对 M(z)^15 的内-内项做五次单位根过滤。

矩阵 M(z) 的行列式为 z^{-1}z - 1 = 0，迹为 z+z^{-1}。因此 M(z)^15 = (z+z^{-1})^14 M(z)。所以内-内项为 z^{-1}(z+z^{-1})^14。

展开：z^{-1}(z+z^{-1})^14 = sum_{k=0}^{14} C(14,k) z^{13-2k}。五次单位根过滤只保留指数能被 5 整除的项，即 13-2k ≡ 0 mod 5。解得 k ≡ 4 mod 5，所以 k=4,9,14。

因此 n = C(14,4)+C(14,9)+C(14,14) = 1001+2002+1 = 3004。所求余数为 3004 mod 1000 = 4。
